item.title: Sub-zero Night grips Kashmir, Ladakh remains Freezing
item.description: Srinagar,Dec 27 : Sub-zero temperatures continued to grip large parts of Kashmir and Ladakh, with Sonamarg in the Valley and Drass in Ladakh emerging as the coldest locations. In the Kashmir Valley, Srinagar recorded a minimum temperature of minus 2.6 degrees Celsius, while Qazigund settled at minus 2.8 degrees. item.title: Man Injured in Leopard Attack in South Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar, Dec 27 : A man was injured in a leopard attack in the Rayathpora Pinjoora area of south Kashmir’s Shopian district on Saturday, officials said. The injured has been identified as Muhammad Maqbool Dar, son of Abdul Rahim Dar, a local inhabitant of Rayathpora Pinjoora, aged around 50 years. He sustained injuries after being attacked by a leopard in the area. Following the incident, locals rushed to his aid and he was immediately shifted to the District Hospital Shopian for treatment. item.title: Northern Railway Launches Special Trains to Katra for New Year Rush
item.description: Srinagar, Dec 27: The Jammu Division of Northern Railway has announced the operation of special reserved trains between New Delhi and Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra to manage the anticipated surge in passenger traffic during the New Year period. The services, each comprising 16 coaches, will run from today until January 1, 2026 to accommodate the heavy flow of pilgrims and tourists to Jammu and Kashmir.
